_help: Copy this file to <country-key>.json (e.g. kyrgyzstan.json) and fill it from OFFICIAL sources.
Every tax/fee is an item in 'items', applied top to bottom. Types:
percent  : rate x base            (base = list of names to add: car, fob, freight, insurance, cif, or ids of earlier items)
per_cc   : rate x engine cc       (rate in 'currency')
per_kw   : rate x electric motor kW
max      : largest of 'options'   (e.g. EAEU: 54% of value but not less than 2.5 EUR/cc)
choose   : first of 'options' whose 'when' matches (age/engine brackets)
'when' filters: fuel [petrol, diesel, hybrid, plug_in_hybrid, ev, lpg], age_min/age_max (years, age_max exclusive), cc_min/cc_max (cc_max exclusive), price_min_usd/price_max_usd (car price).
group: customs (taxes/duties) or local (broker, certification, registration...).
Mark verified=false for anything not confirmed from an official source; it is flagged in the quote.
